source: Pabna Diabetes Hospital, Bangladesh, public table of 465 women
reason: The current diabetes model was not run on these rows. Glucose, skin thickness, insulin, and family history are not the same measurements as the Pima table, so a score would be invented.

mismatches.glucose: Pabna values run from 5 to 45. This model expects plasma glucose of about 44 to 199 mg/dL.
mismatches.skin_thickness_mm: Pabna values run from 29.21 to 406.4. This model expects a triceps skinfold of about 7 to 99 mm.
mismatches.insulin: 334 of 465 insulin values are 0, and the highest recorded value is 44. This model expects 2-hour serum insulin up to the Pima range.
mismatches.family_history: Pabna records a family count from 0 to 8. This model expects the Pima diabetes pedigree score, about 0.078 to 2.42.
